art_direction: County Fair Toy style (docs/art/ART_DIRECTION.md), council-approved 2026-10-04 (docs/art/ART_REVIEW.md): chunky stylized natural horses, small eyes on the sides of the head, no eyelashes or eyebrows, natural coat and mane colours, no flank symbols, ears forward, mouth closed, dark high-contrast hooves on every coat. Hero horse is never a buckskin mustang with a flowing black mane. No whip, no wagering imagery, no Spirit / My Little Pony / Horse Life / Wild Horse Islands / real racing brand look-alikes. The player's avatar is the jockey: never generate a rider.

phase1.note: Playtest set (2026-10-04): horse_gallop 30, five coats 50, grey re-roll 10, finish_post 30, gate_stall 30 + 30.

world.note: David allowed up to 75% of the day's credits; the balance was checked before every batch and never went below 450. Spent per Meshy consumed_credits: 32 text-to-3D slots x 30 = 960, 22 retextures x 10 = 220, re-rolls 2 x 30 (pitchfork, water_trough) + 4 x 10 (pinto and roan, both poses) = 100. flower_planter (30) failed and was dropped. Verdicts: docs/art/ART_REVIEW.md.

horse_life_stage5.note: Stage 5 (D-060), plan asked about 60: rosette_wall 30, post_box_carrots retexture 10, visitor_bell 30 + re-roll 30 (the first had no post). Balance checked before each batch (460, then 390); never near the 150 floor. Verdicts: docs/art/ART_REVIEW.md.

stage4.note: Horse life stage 4 (D-058, docs/plans/horse-life-and-retention.md). Balance checked before every job (stage 5 was also using Meshy). spa_wash_stall 30, horse_lie_bay 30, towel_rack 30, retextures horse_lie_palomino 10 and horse_lie_grey 10 (the starter coats; other coats sink a standing horse into straw). Verdicts: docs/art/ART_REVIEW.md.

stage6.note: Horse life stage 6 (D-063). Hard cap 50, never below 150 (stage 7 needs the rest); balance checked before each job (250, 240). welcome_hay_bale retexture of hay_bale 10, photo_frame_stand text-to-3D 30, no re-rolls. Verdicts: docs/art/ART_REVIEW.md.

stage7.note: Horse life stage 7 (D-059). Cap 50 with a 150 floor (another builder was spending at the same time), so all three are retextures (10 each) instead of text-to-3D: legend_paddock_arch from trail_gate_arch, riding_school_sign and legend_plaque_post from noticeboard. Balance checked before each job: 210, 200, 190. riding_school_sign replaces the plan's riding_school_trailer. Verdicts: docs/art/ART_REVIEW.md.
